journal_lines: Witch in the clearing. Moved fast.
Cackle in the dark. Found it before it found me.
Slowness on the paws. Still moved fast enough.
She threw fire at me first. That was unexpected.
The flask hit the ground near my foot. Stepped back quickly.
Found it in its own hut. Startled by the company.
One potion missed. The second one didn't. Still here.
She was healing herself between throws. Ended that.
Multiple potion types. Categorized them in transit.
The inventory she carries is alarming. Relieved her of most of it.
Night witch. Heard the cackle first.
The fire resist helped. Went through the smoke.
